summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. The settings remained effective after a verified node reboot, with networking fully recovered. The installed Alpine release and kernel were unchanged.
actions_performed: Created /etc/sysctl.d/99-ipv4-network-hardening.conf with accept_redirects=0 and accept_source_route=0 for all and default IPv4 interfaces.
Applied the controls immediately to all existing interfaces.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified a changed boot identity.
Confirmed the persistent configuration, live sysctl values, networking services, address, routes, and reachability after restart.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: Shows the persistent configuration and zero live values for all, default, eth0, and lo, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows Alpine Linux v3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts unchanged.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, then recovered networking and persistent hardened state.
